three_judgments.path: FAILS (automatic §4 kill). Bull mechanism: EyeProGPO (1,800 members) + Cyclo G6 utilization re-accelerate revenue AND contract-mfg outsourcing drives a structural margin/FCF step-up, re-rating a ~$28M cap multi-fold. Tested vs the 4 discriminators (§7) it SHOWS zero: no backlog/RPO (none exists); no on-date binary milestone (EyeProGPO is a preferred-pricing GPO listing, 'driver in coming quarters', no $ guidance — access channel, not firm order); no firm-cash Tier-1 anchor (a GPO discount is the opposite of a fixed-price anchor); and the one a V-turn needs — margin/CF inflection — is ASSERTED for 2027, not printed: Q1 GM went the WRONG way YoY (40% vs 43%, tariffs + transition reserves), adj-EBITDA FELL YoY ($259K vs $415K), CFO guides margins merely 'normalize to high-30s/low-40s' (flat), and contract-mfg full implementation is 2027. FY-positive OCF is back-half-weighted on 'sell-through inventory + collect receivables' (working-capital timing, not a margin step). Revenue is structurally flat-to-declining: $53.9M(21)→$57.0M(22)→$51.9M(23)→$48.7M(24)→$52.7M(25)→$51-53M guide(26) — no top-line inflection. A credible ≥4x needs heroic stacking (re-accel AND structural margin AND multiple expansion on a no-growth, margin-compressing, perennial-breakeven micro-cap whose own strategic review already FAILED to find a buyer). Neither a credible ≥4x (multibagger) nor a high-confidence/protected 3-4x (great trade — 'high-confidence' and 'protected' both fail).
three_judgments.asymmetry: Weak. Bull ~2-3x (modest re-rate IF FCF proves out and a quality multiple returns) at LOW probability; base ~flat (perennial breakeven, ~$28M cap drifts); bear ~-40-60% (another dilutive raise on $4.6M cash; continued retina decline). Capped, low-confidence upside vs real dilution downside ≈ U/D well under the healthy ratio the gate requires — does not clearly dominate.
three_judgments.survival: Clears the ruin bar — NOT the disqualifier. Working capital $11.8M, convertible note only $3.765M, no going-concern flag, guided FY-positive OCF; pre-profit not penalized (§7). BUT cash is thin at $4.6M with a demonstrated dilution pattern (Mar-2025 $10M Novel strategic investment + $10M option). Permanent-impairment risk is dilution, not insolvency. The kill is J1 (no credible path), not survival.

strongest_bear: IRIX is a structurally no-growth ~$53M-revenue ophthalmic-laser micro-cap that has hovered around breakeven for half a decade; its own strategic review to 'unlock shareholder value' FAILED to produce a sale and ended in a dilutive $10M raise (the best-informed buyers passed). The headline 'turn' is cost-cutting on a flat base with the real margin catalyst (contract mfg) deferred to 2027, while GM and adj-EBITDA actually fell YoY and retina revenue is declining — the textbook value trap the V-discriminators exist to catch.
